lastResponse.text: You’re right to want someone who knows appeals. In Eugene, I can give you a local benefits-assistance office: Plaza de Nuestra Comunidad, 195 West twelfth Avenue. Their number is 5 4 1 … 6 8 7 … 2 6 6 7. They help with benefits forms, and you can ask directly for someone experienced with disability benefit appeals. If you want, keep it minimal and just say: “I need appeals-focused disability benefits help, not general intake.”
